name: Kokoa
source:
Kokoa is a manager of a supermarket. She views convenience stores as inferior to supermarkets, and because of this, she comes off quite hostile to [url=/c12299]Chris[/url] at first. 

[spoiler]Kokoa is semi-hidden romanceable character, though her level of interaction otherwise would be indistinguishable from a minor character. She is not listed among the official main characters on sites like Getchu, but does have her own character image and scene reminiscence section.[/spoiler]

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Popotan_characters#Kokoa]Wikipedia[/url].]
